item.title: British businesses caught in Europe-wide supermarket fridge attacks
item.description: Supermarket and grocery store refrigerator controls across Europe were hacked in the early hours of Monday in the second such wave of attacks in recent weeks — following a first wave in France — with unidentified perpetrators defrosting fridges and causing stock to spoil.

item.title: Binance CEO says ‘months-long campaign’ led to $6.3 billion theft as N. Korea denies responsibility
item.description: North Korean attackers "combined a range of techniques, including social engineering by fake recruitment interviews," Binance said about the multibillion-dollar crypto heist it discovered in October.

item.title: Russia dismantles infrastructure of VasyGrek cybercrime group, detains three suspects
item.description: Russia's Interior Ministry said Monday that police had dismantled the group's infrastructure and identified its suspected members following an investigation conducted with assistance from cybersecurity firm Kaspersky.

item.title: Russia-linked cyber spies target Ukraine's war crimes investigations, military aid routes
item.description: The hackers use relatively simple malware to steal sensitive documents, login credentials and other information from Ukrainian organizations, particularly those near the front line and the Russian border.

item.title: UK faces ‘unprecedented rise’ in cyberattacks in coming months, warns cyber chief
item.description: "[V]ulnerabilities that have been tolerated for far too long can now be discovered and exploited at a scale that was once unimaginable," the NCSC's chief will warn in releasing the agency's annual report.
